prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Design Your Desktop Companion", "Customize your pet's appearance and view instant desktop preview responses.", "Select Species & Personality"]
1: ["Welcome Your Companion Home", "Your desktop pet is ready to join your workspace.", "Try Desktop Pet Controls", "Practice hiding, summoning, and dragging your companion before completing setup.", "Click pet to chat | Drag to move | Right-click to hide"]
2: ["Upload Pet Photo for AI Customization", "Our automatic photo check ensures optimal clarity for 3D desktop rendering.", "Photo Clarity & Render Quality Check", "Validating lighting, contrast, and subject outline for optimal desktop pet generation.", "Analyzing background separation...", "High Quality Match"]
3: ["Sign In to Save or Restore Your Companion", "Select whether you are starting a new pet journey or recovering a pet from a previous account.", "New Companion Account", "Restore Existing Account Pet"]
4: ["Preparing Companion Desktop Environment", "Synthesizing pet animations and configuring desktop overlay settings...", "Allocating background pet physics and interaction engine."]
5: ["Choose How Your Pet Interacts On Your Desktop", "Select Focus Buddy for calm task assistance, or Playful Companion for active desktop interactions.", "You can change companion behavior and appearance anytime in settings."]
6: ["We will notify your system tray as soon as your pet is live on your desktop."]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Name your companion and claim your official desktop companion badge.", "Enter Pet Name", "Official Desktop Companion Verified"]
8: ["Quick controls: Double-click pet to summon menu, Shift+Drag to relocate desktop anchor.", "Control shortcuts & gestures"]
9: ["Meet Your Virtual Desktop Roommate", "A living desktop companion that hangs out, works alongside you, and brings your screen to life."]
